name: Color Detection out of Bounds
hint: A detected RGB channel value outside 0–255 cannot represent a valid color reading, so color-based decisions may be ignored or behave unpredictably.
instruction: Keep each detected color channel as an integer from 0 through 255 before using it in a comparison.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB [red v] color value detected :: sensing) > (300)> then
say [Invalid color]
end
